graphOpen.description: The Git Scope graph view was opened.

action.description: A repository-mutating git action ran (e.g. reset, merge, addWorktree). Never includes repository content — no commit messages, branch names, paths, or error text.

commonProperties: Standard properties added by @vscode/extension-telemetry (VS Code version, extension version, machine id, OS, etc.). See https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-extension-telemetry
optOut: Respects the VS Code 'telemetry.telemetryLevel' setting. Set it to 'off' to disable all telemetry.
